headline: Soy feliz en Barcelona
content: mJugador brasileño desmintió a la prensa de su país, que señaló que tenía todo listo para ir al PSG. Nadie lo mueve del Barcelona. headline: Actualidad | Paso a paso. La Segunda Sala Penal de Apelaciones...
content: Yo respaldo a todos los fiscales cuando hacen bien la cosa, y Gerónimo Juarez lo está haciendo bien.  Pablo Silva, Fiscal de la causa (17/07/2023). The resource presented by lawyers for the former presidential couple was adopted last week... Each lawyer responded for their respective appeal. It was the attorney for Humala who arrived first at the location of the Criminal Appeals Court (1:30 PM) to submit documents. After doing so, he declared before the press that he had arguments to refute the courts ruling. He explained that the preventive detention ordered has been issued disproportionately, and were explaining based on several precedents why Judge Ricardo Concepción did not have the possibility of issuing other alternative measures such as travel restrictions within the country or conduct rules different than imprisonment. It’s mentioned that there were sufficient elements of conviction to deprive freedom to the former presidential pair during investigations. They argued against what the prosecutor said about closing the case circle. Later it was the turn of the attorney representing Heredia, arriving past 3:00 PM. To change a conditional release measure to preventative prison requires reasonable suspicion of flight risk, stated Pedraza. However, his client attended every required procedure diligently showing up for fingerprint registration among others. Sources indicated that the chamber led by Sahuanay should hold hearings next Monday or Tuesday to listen to parties’ statements regarding whether the appeals filed by those detained, Ollanta Humala and Nadine Heredia, would proceed.

headline: Del Director
content: Over recent years due to various reasons, much learning occurred concerning our justice system—or rather injustice—as some might say more accurately. Discussions around institutional reforms, though broad and somewhat nebulous now, could see significant changes through specific actions alone over time. For instance, penalties accumulating rather than overlapping each other where only major ones take effect incentivizes committing minor crimes knowing additional minimal punishment wont follow—a situation exacerbated further given lenient tendencies like ‘double-time reduction,’ coupled with lengthy legal processes making severe offenses effectively negligible after many years thus skewing societal benefit-cost analysis unfavorably towards society itself.

headline: Comisión permanente votará la proposición del Gobierno, pero anoche Fuerza Popular anunció su intención de sustentar su candidatura
content: Almost assured and consecrated today. The Fuerza Popular bloc decided yesterday evening to vote in support of economist candidate Nelson Shack proposed by the executive branch for the position of public comptroller. Given the substantial majority held by the Fujimorist block in the Permanent Commission (12 out of 22 members), its election seems almost certain today. Shack arrives at voting backed by a report prepared by a subgroup tasked specifically with evaluating his candidacy credentials including academic qualifications, professional experience, absence of any legal hindrances, along with proposals intended for reforming the institution under consideration.

headline: FP suspende por 60 días a Kenji Fujimori

According to a statement released by Fuerza Popular, it was noted that the special disciplinary committee proposed such sanction and exhorted Congressman Fujimori to reflect during said period about adhering to principles of commitment and cohesion within the group.
